searchText: Hey Guys 👋 I'm back Hi, we found that Prysm and Lighthouse are using different buckets for the getBlobs latency histogram, and this seems to be the reason for the 10s latency spike. I opened a PR on Prysm to fix this (https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/16844) Before combining the two metrics -> We are working on improving the latency, but it would be nice to have more accurate statistics in the meantime 🙂
